run_label: gate_b_cortex_motor — cortical tension trajectory from NMII binding events

build.reason: /home/sungwook/ffn_ac_native is not a git repository; the commit is the caller's assertion and was not verified here

evidence_basis: recorded the per-sample cortical tension, its source/network split and the bound-head count over accepted physical steps at the stated population, and judged each series for stationarity (gamma_total: STATIONARY). BLOCKED because every NMII magnitude here is a PI-GAP (k_xb, f_stall, kappa, N_side, L_bb) and every step is force-accepted rather than admitted on the balance predicate

t0.note: the first ACCEPTED step; heads start unbound, so t0 is the state after one dt

timing.device_note: telemetry (gamma readback + host force norm) runs BETWEEN steps every 5 step(s) and is included in this wall-clock; it is not free — at native it dominated the per-step cost until the stride existed
timing.not_comparable_reason: the gate verdict is absent, so this run did not establish the convergence its cost would have to be quoted at. Quoting it as the engine's speed compares the cost of NOT converging

bound_head_lifetime.derivation: Pereverzev two-pathway at zero load: k_catch0 + k_slip0 = 0.35 + 0.35 = 0.7 /s; mean_load_s = 1/<k_off> over the bound heads' own Bell loads through the same closed form the device kernel implements
